dailyTopNewsBrief.headline: Raiders (4-7) Week 12 Briefing: Wednesday Injury Report Ahead of Browns
bullets: Injury & Practice Status: Las Vegas opened DE Patrick Johnson's 21-day IR practice window alongside limited work for DT Tonka Hemingway (stinger) and TE Brock Bowers (ankle) [Las Vegas Raiders Official](https://www.raiders.com/team/transactions/#tx-252c14d3bac6). DT Adam Butler (concussion) and DT Tim Keenan III (knee) did not practice Wednesday, while TE Michael Mayer (back) and WR Dareke Young (stinger) practiced in full [raiders.com Official](https://www.raiders.com/news/raiders-browns-week-12-injury-report).

Week 12 Browns Outlook: Klint Kubiak and DC Rob Leonard open installation for the Cleveland Browns (6-4, CLE -4.5, HC Todd Monken, OC Travis Switzer & DC Mike Rutenberg (Road Test)) as Las Vegas prepares for a pivotal AFC matchup [Bill Williamson](https://www.silverandblackpride.com/las-vegas-raiders-news/147424/raiders-news-brock-bowers-returns-practice-wednesday) [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/preview?gameId=401873086).

AFC Playoff Trajectory: Entering Week 12 at 4-7 (3rd in AFC West • #10 Seed in AFC), Las Vegas carries a 8.6% postseason projection, 0% AFC West division title mark, and 0% #1 Seed Bye equity into the conference stretch [raiders.com Official](https://www.raiders.com/news/raiders-browns-week-12-injury-report).

Around the Beat: Hemingway did not play in the Raiders' Week 11 loss to the Broncos due to a stinger injury [Ryan McFadden](https://www.espn.com/nfl/player/_/id/4429109/tonka-hemingway#:~:text=Hemingway%20%28upper%20body%29%20was%20a%20limited%20participant).

Statistical Profile & Matchup Edge: Through Week 11, Las Vegas ranks #11 in Points / Game (25.0), #32 in Points Allowed / Game (29.7), #12 in Turnover Differential (+3), giving Klint Kubiak and Rob Leonard a clear benchmark ahead of Sun, Nov 29, 5:20 PM PST • NFL TV at [object Object] against the Cleveland Browns [Bill Williamson](https://www.silverandblackpride.com/las-vegas-raiders-news/147424/raiders-news-brock-bowers-returns-practice-wednesday).
